WITH order_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    o.o_orderkey,
    c.c_mktsegment,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment
)

  SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue), 2) AS furniture_revenue_percentage
FROM order_revenue
